display.title: Episode 515: The Big Surprise (Parshas Terumah-Tetzaveh)
display.summary_short: Uncle Yossi explains why the Mishkan was built after Matan Torah and how every Jew is a small sanctuary, then tells how a poor sand seller's stolen wagon came home full of treasure.
display.summary_long: Broadcast between Parshas Terumah and Tetzaveh. Uncle Yossi explains why Hashem commanded the Mishkan right after the giving of the Torah: at Har Sinai the people saw Hashem's glory so openly that their souls left them, and Hashem revived them with the dew of revival that will one day bring techiyas hameisim. When they begged to see Hashem's glory again, He told them to build a sanctuary so He could dwell 'among them', in each Jew. Every mitzvah invites the Shechinah to rest on us. After the Hakochainik march, a first-grade class from a Crown Heights yeshiva says the Shema with their teacher, and everyone gives tzedakah. Story time: Rabbi Yitzchak, a poor, pious sand seller who always gives tzedakah, finds his horse and wagon stolen. His family prays with Tehillim and trusts that all is for the good. In the forest the thief finds a chest of treasure in the sand, but the cave collapses on him, and the horse brings the wagon and treasure home. A listener's letter asks where to get a Shulchan Aruch, followed by a reminder of 'Shivisi Hashem' and candle-lighting times.
display.lesson: Whatever Hashem does is for the good; trust in Him and pray, and every mitzvah makes us a home for the Shechinah.
